visual_description: A sturdy, rectangular hand-held sifting screen, approximately 12x18 inches. It has a robust, unfinished wooden frame with visible wood grain, featuring a comfortable handle grip on each of the shorter sides. The screen mesh is made of durable, rust-resistant fine metal wire, securely fastened within the frame. There are traces of dried mud and sand on the frame and within the mesh, indicating recent field use.

constraints.texture: Visible wood grain on frame; fine, interwoven metal mesh texture; subtle dried mud/sand texture.
